limitations: available_date is a conservative model-use date, not an exact release timestamp.
Dated official archives avoid using later time-series revisions; retroactive corrections to archive files cannot be ruled out without contemporaneous snapshots.
Only current-week fundamentals and latest five daily price columns are extracted. Older comparative columns are not backfilled to their observation dates.
EIA commercial crude stocks change lease-stock coverage in October 2016; do not treat the level discontinuity as a genuine inventory shock.
Monthly revised/backcast indexes and CFTC without verified release dates are excluded from this supplementary modeling dataset.
